name: ハッカソン報告ボット
tagline: Auto-posts a running X thread recapping a hackathon hashtag
description: Point it at an event hashtag and it watches new posts while the hackathon runs, condensing each into a one-line summary on a growing thread, with a link back to the original post. When the end time you set arrives it stops posting by itself. Built for organizers and teams who want the day recounted automatically.
author: sat0xshi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
